system_overview: This specification extends the EWD998Chan termination detection algorithm with configurable algorithm variants (feature flags) for statistical efficiency analysis. It defines four optimization variants (pt1 through pt4) that modify token passing behavior, and instruments the specification to collect statistics about the number of steps between system termination and termination detection. The data is written to CSV files for subsequent statistical analysis.
actors_and_components: The system consists of the same channel-based ring of nodes as EWD998Chan, augmented with feature flags that control algorithm variant behavior. The feature flags are: pt1 (active node may pass token if node is tainted), pt2 (active node may pass token if token is tainted), pt3 (return token to initiator if node is black, aborting the current round), and pt4 (return token to initiator if token is black, aborting the current round).
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from EWD998Chan. A TLC register tracks the state level at which termination occurs for measuring detection delay.
initial_state: A simulation-oriented initial state constrains all nodes to start active with white color, representing a typical implementation starting point rather than allowing arbitrary initial states.
actions: The specification redefines the token passing action with variant behavior controlled by feature flags: the standard pass condition (node inactive) is extended with optional conditions (pt1: node is black, pt2: token is black), and the token destination may be redirected to the initiator (pt3: node is black, pt4: token is black) instead of the next node in the ring.
model_bounds: The specification is designed for TLC's generator mode with unlimited depth and no deadlock checking. The feature flag set and number of nodes are configured via environment variables.
additional_assumptions: Requires TLC, TLCExt, IOUtils, and CSV community modules. TLC must run in generator mode. The specification uses action constraints and state constraints to collect statistics at termination detection points. Feature flags and node count are provided via IOEnv environment variables. A minimum TLC revision timestamp is enforced.
